expectations.evidence: "did not repeal or suspend 32 CFR Part 170"; "252.204-7021 (the CMMC flow-down clause itself)... remain fully enforceable"; "paused, not cancelled"

expectations.text: DID NOT: change baseline obligations — 7012/7019/7020, 800-171 Rev 2, SPRS scores, affirmations all continue
expectations.evidence: "7012... 7019... 7020... remain fully enforceable"; "110 NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 practices"; "SPRS score submissions, and senior-official annual affirmations all continue"
